title: Champagne news-letters to Nevers 1590-91 and Laurière to Nevers 1593, BnF fr. 3623 and fr. 3625 (catalogue item 30)

steps.what: Tomokiyo's nevers.htm and GL.htm, DECODE list for fr. 3623/3625; no prior reading; DECODE gives folios.
Gallica thumbnails of both volumes; contact sheets; full-resolution pages of ff. 35-41, 88, 111 (fr. 3623) and ff. 10, 16 (fr. 3625).
No. 23: key slip on f. 36r transcribed; every code number in the letter resolves.
Tomokiyo's no. 46 (targets/nevers1593/key46.txt) tried on no. 24's figures: values do not fit.
Twelve two-digit runs of nos. 24, 25, 60 transcribed with the faint interlinear letters.
Interlinear glosses (Ludovic, union, a, n) give anchors; the values rise with the alphabet.
Alphabetical slots fill the table: la ligue, de la defiance du [17], de Chazeron, service read; two no. 24 runs stay open.
Search for fr. 3625 no. 55 across canvases 13-64 and 81-200: not found; no. 10 found at f. 10r with interlinear decipherment.
OAI item list of fr. 3625 matched to folios (no. 49 = f. 61, dated 3 not 9 July); no. 55 found at f. 66r, canvas 143; canvases 65-80 and 201-270 looked over.
No. 55 transcribed (8 runs, 86 groups); first three runs of no. 10 aligned with their interlinear decipherment.
Groups shared with no. 10's glossed runs read in no. 55: que le Roy soit encores, la volonte du pape, aussitost; about 15 of 86 groups.
All seven glossed runs of no. 10 aligned with their interlinear decipherment; 12-entry table (key_lauriere.txt), syllable groups not separable.
No. 55 read with the table: 19 of 86 groups; French LM not applicable to the syllabic remainder.

GitHub issue 13 (setsunaatto): Tomokiyo's Nevers key no. 57 (fr. 3995 ff. 102-103, 'Mons. de La Verriere', Chartres Feb 1593) is Lauriere's key; our 12-entry table is one group out of step. Tomokiyo's nevers.htm entry for no. 57 confirms the design and the writer.
Key sheet canvases 196-201 fetched; syllable rule (ba 1 be 15 bi 29 bo 43 bu 57), doubles 73-98 and every word code used in no. 55 checked on canvas 200; key57.txt written.

Issue's transcription of f. 66r lines 1-2 checked against the full-resolution page and our own ct_3625_55.txt: figures agree group for group. Issue's blind test on no. 10: 80% of glossed letters in runs >=4 vs shuffle max 30%.

No. 55 read in full with key no. 57 (reading_3625_55.txt): Henri IV's assembly, Lorraine's terms, the Pope's consent, Gondi for Tuscany; two letters missing in the cipher itself. key_lauriere.txt marked superseded.
Key no. 57 tried on no. 78's single group '96 □ 3 9̄ f 3': no sense.

Blind test of key no. 57 on no. 10 (f. 10r), contributed by setsunaatto in PR 15: five runs transcribed from crops that hide the office's interlinear decipherment, then scored against it (check_3625_10.py): 157 of 196 gloss letters fall in matching runs of 4 or more, against shuffled controls of at most 58 in 2000 (121/160 against at most 42 without L1, the run seen when the key was first applied).

No. 10's other eight glossed runs read with key no. 57 (transcribed with the glosses in view; 311/354 in matching runs of 4 or more) and 21 word numbers added to key57.txt from the sheet. Apart from spelling and gaps in the gloss, key and office disagree only in run R3: 'que [l'Espagne]' where the office wrote 'qui ne se', and 344 234 'tout hault' where it wrote 'pour son' (probably a slip for 334 'son').

PR 15 checked before merging: the script reproduces its table; our 21 Sept transcription of runs L1-L3 agrees with the blind one on every figure group but one; 18 of the 21 new word numbers, both duplicates (202, 320) and province 29 found on f. 103r; both header rows match the script's alphabet, which showed key57.txt had c and h reversed (corrected); swapping the e/i y-forms moves the blind score only from 157 to 152; the R3 figures 344 234 confirmed on f. 10r.

No. 10's one unglossed run transcribed from the page (U1 in ct_3625_10_rest.txt) and read: '[le grand duc de Toscane] quant [le Roy] nous bailla par escrit (sa?) volonté'; the barred 3 before 'volonté' is not on the sheet, 'sa' is a guess from context.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The two-digit alphabet of fr. 3623 nos. 24/25/60 was rebuilt from a few interlinear glosses on nos. 25 and 60 plus its alphabetical order, and the no. 55 groups from the interlinear decipherment of Lauriere's letter no. 10 in the same volume fr. 3625; no. 23 reads with its own key slip bound in at f. 36r. Laurière's no. 55 was then read in full with his own key sheet (Tomokiyo's Nevers key no. 57, fr. 3995 ff. 102-103), identified by an outside contributor (issue 13) and checked here.
outcome.fraction_read_source: ct_3623_twodigit.txt 63 of 104 (NOTES readings table) + ct_3625_55.txt 85 of 86 (all cipher groups read with key no. 57; '9P' is a clear abbreviation) + ct_3623_78.txt 0 of 6: 148 of 196, 29 Sept 2026. No. 23 (all names in its key) not counted.
outcome.notes: No. 23 read in full from its key; nos. 24/25/60 about three quarters of runs read; no. 55 19 of 86 groups from no. 10's glosses; no. 78 open. fraction_read 0.45 is an estimate from the notes (cipher tokens: about 70 of 104 two-digit figures, 19 of 86 no. 55 groups, no. 23 codes all, no. 78 none), not a measurement. Measured 21 Sept 2026: 0.418 (was 0.45 estimated). codes_open = the word codes of the nos. 24/25/60 table (12 = de read; 16, 17, 19, 39, 89, 99 open); no. 55's syllabic groups (67 of 86 open) not counted there. 29 Sept 2026: no. 55 read in full with key no. 57 (issue 13); fraction 0.755.

gaps.item: Nos. 24/25/60 code numbers 12, 16, 17, 19, 39, 89, 99 and the plain numbers of no. 24 (22, 51, 84, 44)
gaps.detail: no key bound with these letters; the alphabetical two-digit table covers letters only

gaps.item: No. 24 two passages, first half of the no. 25 'qu'on dict' passage, the name in no. 60 ('de la V?an')
gaps.detail: values fall outside the anchored slots of the alphabetical table (30-39, 48, 92-99 uncertain); no gloss over them

gaps.item: No. 78 (f. 111r), one group of about six mixed signs
gaps.detail: a single group, probably a name, in a different mixed code

prior.where: no. 23 key slip bound with the letter (f. 36r); interlinear glosses in no. 25 and no. 60; for no. 55 the key sheet itself (fr. 3995 ff. 102-103), catalogued by Tomokiyo as Nevers key no. 57

human: Project-level: set up Claude Code and posed the catalogue task via a parent agent. No target-specific intervention recorded. 29 Sept 2026: the key identification for no. 55 came from an outside contributor (setsunaatto, GitHub issue 13); this session verified it against the key sheet and the page. 30 Sept 2026: the same contributor (working with Claude, by their account) added a blind test of the key on no. 10 (PR 15); this session reviewed it against the key sheet and the page and merged it.
